Dashboard bands, one look per tone

Every full-width strip on the dashboard now belongs to one of four families. The shape stays identical (kicker, title, one line, meta, button, pager). Only the wash, the glow and the voice colour change. No borders anywhere; the wash and a soft offset shadow carry the edge. Brand red is kept for one family only, so it means something again.
